europa.definition: Net downward liquid transfer across z=0; actual saved flow states only
europa.flux_decomposition: Darcy term is integrated directly from saved qr and annular areas. Solid-carried term = exact CSV transfer increment/time minus Darcy term.

cold_warm.profile_representation: Exact x=10.1 km cell column; piecewise constant over actual cells; no field/time interpolation.

conduction.interpretation: Positive/negative cell sums are signs of time-integrated Eulerian cell contributions, not gross time integrals of positive/negative flux. Whole-domain conductive gain cancels at insulated walls; net lower-half input does not measure internal redistribution.

inherited_enhanced_conductivity.note: Existing ocean-style kappaPrime=100 rule retained in both solvers. Ordinary conductivity is phi*0.56+(1-phi)*3.3 W/(m K).

frozen.source: corrected shared S3 solver used by verified one-year run
frozen.scope: Identical frozen H, phi, T, geometry, rheology, gravity and walls within each pair; only kc changes. The low-kc one-year-state control is not a low-kc evolved trajectory.

face.selection: Lowest common initially dry cell wetted in step 1 with liquid entering downward through its top face.
face.definition: q is Darcy volume flux per face area [m/s]; Q=q*A is volume/time; local Q_into is positive inward. All cells are full axisymmetric annuli.

dilation.scope: Frozen saved-flow budget screening. bulk contains upwind diffusion; phase is an effective enthalpy residual. Algebraic budget closure is an identity, not an independent verification. Positive C in wet material does not prove pore creation in initially dry material or causal control of the migration speed.

transport.definition: Prescribed vertical velocity -10 m/year, initial phi=0.2 top-hat from z=4 to 6 km, transported for 100 years; exact cell averages, no interpolation.
transport.scope: Transport-operator benchmark only; not a coupled Europa trajectory convergence study.

regularization.scope: Frozen-state flow sensitivity, not reruns of either trajectory; controlled advection benchmark, not full coupled grid convergence.

flat_center.physical_change_between_setups: initial water shape only; flat starts with twice the water volume
flat_center.rheology: same regularized Europa shear law; 1e9 Pa s minimum shear coefficient
